summary: P5: one owner for the bronze-and-vellum palette and type scale (game/themes/bronze_vellum.tres), the reusable UI components D11's rail and command grid become, and the calm information surface B13 asks for -- Ambient, Notable, Urgent by explicit rule, S6's explanation before a directive is confirmed, S11's journal readable while paused, and B9's three accessibility settings applied live through the Theme.

coordination.notes: game/project.godot takes one appended autoload at the END of [autoload]. godot_bridge.rs takes one read-only #[func] appended at the END of the Project42ExpeditionBridge impl block plus its projection helpers after the existing free functions; nothing existing is edited. settings_panel.gd keeps its whole public API (PAUSE_REASON, SETTINGS_PATH, text_scale, high_contrast, reduced_motion, set_*, load_settings, save_settings, close, close_button) and stops declaring its own hex values -- the Theme owns them after this card. The two prototypes (world/expedition_prototype.gd, battle/battle_prototype.gd, paper_card.gd, paper_skill_diamond.gd) are NOT edited: they adopt the Theme in P6 and P7.
